steps.title: Open Supabase dashboard
steps.instruction: Create a project or open your existing Supabase project.

steps.title: API keys
steps.instruction: Copy Project URL and anon/public key into .env.

steps.title: Database connection
steps.instruction: Copy the connection string (use pooler for serverless). Server-side only — never expose in client code.

steps.title: Auth URL configuration
steps.instruction: Set Site URL to your Vercel preview or production URL. Add the same URL to Redirect URLs with /** wildcard.

steps.title: Row Level Security
steps.instruction: Enable RLS on tables that hold user data. Add policies for authenticated users.

steps.title: Apply migrations
steps.instruction: Run supabase db push or apply SQL migrations so production schema matches the repo.
